entities.text: outstanding lead actress in a comedy series

nary_nodes.label: Emmy nominations unveiled
evidence: The nominees for the 78th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards were unveiled Wednesday, with Hollywood honoring a slew of new shows and setting up what’s expected to be a battle among two legends in the race for outstanding lead actress in a comedy series.

nary_nodes.label: Emmy Awards ceremony
evidence: The Emmy Awards will be hosted by “Law & Order: Special Victims Unit” star Mariska Hargitay and will air live on Monday, September 14 at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on NBC, streaming on Peacock.

nary_nodes.label: The Pitt receives 25 nominations
evidence: The HBO Max medical drama notched 25 nominations, the most of any show.

nary_nodes.label: Widow's Bay receives 19 nominations
evidence: The other big headline in the outstanding comedy category? The strong showing from “Widow’s Bay,” which earned 19 nominations.

nary_nodes.label: Euphoria snubbed in top category
evidence: “Euphoria” was snubbed in the top category after a divisive final season, but still earned acting nods for Zendaya and Colman Domingo.

nary_nodes.label: Heated Rivalry ineligible for Emmys
evidence: The gay hockey drama wasn’t eligible for Emmys because it’s an entirely Canadian production.

nary_nodes.label: Connor Storrie nominated for SNL guest appearance
evidence: But co-lead Connor Storrie got an Emmy nod anyway for his guest appearance on “Saturday Night Live.”

nary_nodes.label: Lisa Kudrow nominated for The Comeback
evidence: the likely frontrunners being Lisa Kudrow for “The Comeback” and Jean Smart for “Hacks,” both of whom gave stellar turns in the final seasons of their respective series.

nary_nodes.label: Jean Smart nominated for Hacks
evidence: the likely frontrunners being Lisa Kudrow for “The Comeback” and Jean Smart for “Hacks,” both of whom gave stellar turns in the final seasons of their respective series.

nary_nodes.label: The Bear nominated for comedy series
evidence: “The Bear” still managed to earn a nomination for outstanding comedy series.

nary_nodes.label: Ayo Edebiri and Rob Reiner nominated
evidence: Ayo Edebiri and late Hollywood legend Rob Reiner received nominations for their work on the show

nary_nodes.label: Jeremy Allen White snubbed
evidence: star Jeremy Allen White was snubbed despite previously winning his category twice.

nary_nodes.label: Matthew Rhys nominated for The Beast in Me
evidence: Wednesday was a particularly good day for Rhys, who also scored a nomination in the limited series category for his turn as a menacing billionaire in “The Beast in Me,” opposite costar Claire Danes, who similarly picked up a nod.

nary_nodes.label: Claire Danes nominated for The Beast in Me
evidence: opposite costar Claire Danes, who similarly picked up a nod.

nary_nodes.label: Keri Russell nominated for The Diplomat
evidence: Rhys’ partner, Keri Russell of “The Diplomat,” was also honored for her role as a steely US ambassador on that Netflix drama.

nary_nodes.label: Battle expected between Kudrow and Smart
evidence: setting up what’s expected to be a battle among two legends in the race for outstanding lead actress in a comedy series.
